Clues left behind by @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius} point characters to his false identities. These leads may be pursued through the contacts he made through each still-active alias:

Valerius Nabopalassar (@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.brh2O5CexxurRbM7.JournalEntryPage.YFKg8L1rfWbScqkr#ordo-xenos]{Ordo Xenos} @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#aeldari]{Aeldari} specialist): Records indicate a base of operations for this identity on @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.nLrpWOo3BjHLB0FG]{Proteus Secundus} in the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.d0lv2v4FkeIb43jj]{Drimor Subsector}. The Planetary Governor, the matriarch Gulya, hesitates to allow unauthorised access to an Inquisitorial laboratory. Inquisitors of the Ordo Xenos are held in particular reverence in the Proteus System after xenos meddling drove the inhabitants to war with one another.

Bayezid Karvonan (Long-lost scion to the nobility of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.ZIDINp9DtgCCj1Mg]{Harjus}): House Karvonan of Harjus holds little record of Bayezid Karvonan, having appeared seemingly from nowhere to claim title and land. Taikos is under guard by House Karvonan troops, who will attempt to kill any interlopers. Highborn politicking is cutthroat enough that Bayezid’s guards will see the allegation that their employer is the alias of a heretical Inquisitor as an obvious lie — doubtless part of a plot by another noble.

Selim Iaysus (Semi-legitimate scion of the Iaysus @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.h6Z6Ia2q5RkRUlDG]{Rogue Trader Dynasty}): Characters involved with @UUID[.qMGtMcmwPnXnwPds#strife-i-a-the-void-stalker]{Strife I-A: The Void Stalker} may already have contacts in House Iaysus. The most recent sighting of Captain Selim Iaysus’ vessel was purportedly plying the outer reaches of the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.d0lv2v4FkeIb43jj]{Drimor Subsector}, where it is currently docked to a voidstation above a feral world. Characters attempting to board the vessel to investigate its captain’s quarters may try to do so either under false identities or wielding Inquisitorial authority.

Each of these leads reveals another of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius}’s many bases of operation. Investigating them may reveal information on his current whereabouts, the depths of heretical research on @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#aeldari]{Aeldari} technologies that Thracius has engaged in, as well as stockpiles of Aeldari weaponry. If nothing else, securing them robs the Radical Inquisitor of another hiding place.

Outcome

If characters pursue all known leads and return with information that may lead to @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius}’ whereabouts, their Patron gains +1 Legitimacy. However, before they can act on this information to pursue Thracius, a more significant problem arises from the Herald’s Howl (see @UUID[.4j86iM1J3kqqpOGg]{Conclave VI},). If the characters do not pursue Thracius, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Alis Raud} undertakes this investigation, gaining +1 Legitimacy and gathering information that may be vital for Thracius’ later capture (see @UUID[.AYJ70cmnV5Y6rDDt]{Conclave VII}).

Strife V-B
An Inquisitor Compromised

Eskender Thracius has prepared a gambit to delay the Conclave from declaring him Excommunicate Traitoris, staying their hands for enough time to allow his escape. He has lured Konstan Serranus into a trap, ransoming the Inquisitor’s life to secure his escape.

@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius} may be able to distract the Conclave with the fate of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus}. He uses the cover that the rescue operation provides to escape for the time being, slipping out of the hands of the Conclave. From this position, Thracius moves to cover his tracks and plot new identities to continue what he perceives as his duties to the God-Emperor.

Shortly before the previous Conclave, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Thracius} orchestrated the capture of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus}, who, acting on a tipoff from Kai Varol, was taken prisoner while investigating a cell of the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald’s Howl}.

  • When the vote against @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Thracius} is suggested, he reveals that he knows the location of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Serranus}’ imprisonment.

  • He claims to also have been investigating the same cell, from which he gave the tipoff to @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Serranus}, and is willing to orchestrate Serranus’ rescue to demonstrate his loyalty.

  • If the Conclave accepts his bargain, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Thracius} asks for a cell of acolytes to be deployed to @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.VeiDfnkV55kTAkRw]{Kallastin}, in the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.4LYxCIJ2ansZ5wFk]{Andosk Subsector} — he will guide them remotely to secure the Inquisitor’s release.

Operation

The party departs for Kallastin to retrieve Serranus. They soon become embroiled in a planetary takeover, and more of the Howl's machinations are revealed.

@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Sylvestrine Horst} makes contact with the characters before their deployment — she has ties to the Planetary Governor, and can arrange military support on the surface. However, this is offered with the stipulation that characters and their Patron support her motions in future Conclaves.

On @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.VeiDfnkV55kTAkRw]{Kallastin}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Thracius} makes contact with the characters. They learn that the recently appointed Planetary Governor Phytian de Kallastin has increased the planet’s industrial output considerably, although many of the residents of industrial habs note an increase in mutations among them as a result of excess industrial byproducts, overworked schedules, and lax safety protocols.

In reality, the heightened production has been used by the planet’s sect of the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald’s Howl} as cover for a population boom, allowing @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cultists} to spread through the populace of the planet’s industrial underclass unnoticed; characters who have faced these cultists before will recognise both their mutations, and the insurmountable threat their numbers pose to Kallastin. Given the cover that the heightened production has provided them, characters may suspect the cult has the support of the Planetary Governor.

@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Serranus} is imprisoned in the Cathedral of the Star Children, a disused subterranean manufactorum that serves as a high temple of the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald's Howl}, replete with ornate star maps resembling the one found on @UUID[.qMGtMcmwPnXnwPds#strife-i-c-the-fate-of-the-lucanus]{Calvus Station}. His imprisonment is overseen by a circle of five psykers, who are debating what should be done with him once they squeeze every vermillion-level secret out of him. Their plans range from using the Inquisitor as a bargaining chip to attempting to merge Genestealer genetics with his own — thereby welcoming him into the fold as an asset with which to infiltrate the Inquisition and deflect their investigations.

Characters attempting to recover @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus} find that the Cathedral is lightly defended, considering its importance, suggesting that the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cultists} are not expecting an attack.

There is little initial resistance to attempts to rescue @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Serranus}, but forces muster and converge swiftly upon the Cathedral once word spreads that it is under attack. The @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cults'} forces are practically innumerable, forcing characters into a fighting retreat despite Serranus’ misgivings about leaving the xenos-corrupted heretics alive. If any psykers survive the initial attack, they order the cultists to prioritise slaying Serranus.

Outcome

Rescuing @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus} grants the characters’ Patron +1 Legitimacy and the staunch support of the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.brh2O5CexxurRbM7.JournalEntryPage.YFKg8L1rfWbScqkr#ordo-xenos]{Ordo Xenos} Inquisitor. If informed of the events at the Conclave, Serranus deepens his hatred for @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius}, both for setting him up to be captured, and his willingness to work alongside xenos to achieve his aims.

Attempting the rescue of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Serranus} separates the Conclave for long enough that @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Thracius} is able to make his escape before a vote can be called to declare him Excommunicate Traitoris.

If the Party and their Patron pursue @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Thracius} instead (@UUID[.HAzjoFV6pghpy0ou#strife-v-a-excommunicate-traitoris]{Strife V-A}), @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.sNDdDGlvY5m1HQ4R]{Ksenia Baek} leads the operation to recover @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus}. She recovers Serranus without bloodshed, negotiating with the cultists and offering them future support in exchange for the prisoner. On the surface, she believes that the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald’s Howl }should be allowed to continue its work, drawing the Hive Fleet away from Segmentum Solar — sacrificing the Macharian Sector instead to buy Holy Terra more time.

Conclave V Conclusion

With @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius}’ treachery revealed, the Conclave’s decision has halted one heresy but allowed another to prosper. If @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Serranus} returns alive, he immediately moves to take the reins of pursuing Thracius, having already been in pursuit of one of his false identities. The @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald's Howl}, however, will soon prove an obstacle to any standing Inquisitorial plans

pages.name: Conclave VI
pages.text:
Conclave VI

The Conclave begins amid reports of Genestealer Cult insurgencies rising up throughout the Macharian Sector. As characters arrive at Mare Cinis, they find the Inquisitors already in the Conclave chamber, gazing through its glass dome ceiling at Persepolis far below, the unmistakable fires of war cast as faint flickering lights on the planet’s surface. The day of ascension has come.

Dramatis Personae

In attendance at the sixth Conclave are: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.sNDdDGlvY5m1HQ4R]{Ksenia Baek}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.W50MW8gfyrDts9g3]{Aegidius Halikarn}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Sylvestrine Horst}, and @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Alis Raud}. After his time as a captive of the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Heralds' Howl} Cult, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus} returns to the Conclave with a visible increase of augmetic enhancements — among limbs, he has replaced both his eyes with augmetic sensors. Naturally, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius} has fled since the last Conclave, his whereabouts remains uncertain. Each present Inquisitor is accompanied by extensive retinues and their Interrogators.

Intrigues

@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus} divulges to the Conclave the full extent of the knowledge he has gathered regarding the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald’s Howl} — the vile cultists’ primary aim is to draw the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Tyranid} Hive Fleets towards the Macharian Sector through the use of multiple psychic beacons, with each system marked on their Star Map iconography being the location of one such beacon.

If the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-kryptman-protocol]{Kryptman Protocol} was not already known to the Conclave, whichever Inquisitors are aware of it will reveal it as a potential tool against the Genestealer Cultists and Hive Fleet.

If the characters have begun to suspect Inquisitor @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.sNDdDGlvY5m1HQ4R]{Ksenia Baek} of Radical behaviour, they could approach Kharket Graan for more information. The astropath has worked for Baek for most of their deployment and fears what Baek ultimately has in store for her and that the Inquisitor is sliding towards the Radical, allowing them to plant a double agent in Baek’s retinue. Graan fears Baek will use the Herald’s Howl with the Kryptman Protocol to sacrifice the Macharian Sector and stall Leviathan in the name of Holy Terra and Segmentum Solar.

Strife VI-A
The Fall of Persepolis

On the planet below, a battle rages that may determine the fate of the Macharian Sector. As the administrative centre for the sector, the loss of Persepolis, either to the Genestealer Cultists or through their destruction by Exterminatus, would be unacceptable.

The Conclave is divided. Someone must deal with @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.qLLaIGWiU6Lf6Rjy]{Persopolis}, the sector’s capital world, as the rest of the Macharian Inquisition scatter to quash the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald’s Howl} elsewhere — the Inquisition will be spread thin like it was during the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.X5EFP7IgIUx6CaBW#silence-and-darkness]{Noctis Aeterna}.

  • @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Sylvestrine Horst} has been observing the battlelines of the revolt on @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.qLLaIGWiU6Lf6Rjy]{Persepolis} from the moment it began. She has discerned a pattern of troop movements, with the Genestealer Cultists prioritising the capture of any major communications hubs. She suspects they are communicating with other cells in the sector.

  • @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Sylvestrine Horst}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus}, and @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.W50MW8gfyrDts9g3]{Aegidius Halikarn} all argue in favour of deploying forces to @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.qLLaIGWiU6Lf6Rjy]{Persepolis} to undertake scouting and assassination missions to locate and destroy cult leadership, prioritising the presumed Genestealer Patriarch.

  • @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Alis Raud} and @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.sNDdDGlvY5m1HQ4R]{Ksenia Baek} advocate supporting the cult's rise and destroying it only before it can claim total victory on @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.qLLaIGWiU6Lf6Rjy]{Persepolis}. This would allow the cultists to use the communications networks to rouse the the wider @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald's Howl}, tricking the cult into revealing itself across the sector.

If the characters seek to resolve this Strife, their Patron has enough sway with the Conclave to approach this mission in whichever manner the players advise.

Operation

The characters deploy to Persepolis, finding the planet wracked by the spreading conflict. Even if they manage to quell the Genesteaeler’s Cultists' initial strikes and their part in the Herald’s Howl, it could take them years to track down and purge the last of them.

Note that any missions the characters undertake on the surface will inevitably bear the risk of engaging in combat, and their Patron advises they bring the greatest complement of weaponry they can gather. If there is anything the characters need or have been asking for a long time, the stockpiles at @UUID[.Y1wjtyi7JdgHxQiF#mare-cinis]{Mare Cinis} should be open to them.

Fighting to quash the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald’s Howl}: The Conclave arranges for the characters to have access to Sector Lord @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.X5EFP7IgIUx6CaBW#governance]{Aulus Sejanus’s} war room in the spire of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.qLLaIGWiU6Lf6Rjy#hive-skarthius]{Hive Skarthius}. Sejanus recognises their involvement as a vital means of tipping the scales of this revolt in his favour and shares any information with them that could prove helpful in determining where to strike. With access to a wing of Valkyries for swift deployment and extraction, missions to defeat the uprising may include:

  • Surveillance missions to root out and detect priority targets.

  • Hunts for Genestealer Cultist Maguses, tacticians, and field commanders.

  • Investigating organisations who may have aided in the Cult’s rise to power.

These missions will likely culminate in a strike to destroy the Genestealer Patriarch, located deep in the lower levels of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.qLLaIGWiU6Lf6Rjy#hive-skarthius]{Hive Skarthius}, orchestrating the cult's revolt from below ground. By now, their insurgency is so deeply rooted that purging them could be a ripe task for the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.brh2O5CexxurRbM7.JournalEntryPage.YFKg8L1rfWbScqkr#the-deathwatch]{Deathwatch}.

Fighting to see the Cults rise: The characters deploy to an Inquisitorial safehouse in hive Skarthius. The Inquisition will not undertake military actions themselves, as any direct engagement would put characters into a battle on two fronts — the Genestealer Cultists would not recognise them as allies, and those defending the planet would treat them as part of the revolt. If captured, execution is near certain, although characters may be able to level Inquisitorial authority or their support of the revolt to buy their escape. Their missions to aid the Genestealer Cultists may include:

  • Sabotaging Imperial supply lines and transport links.

  • Luring defenders away from Genestealer Cultist activity.

  • Ensuring Genestealer Cultists capture communication arrays across the planet.

Once the Genestealer Cultists capture the planet’s hive cities, the operation is deemed a success. The characters will be extracted while arrangements are made to begin a counteroffensive. Again, this task would suit Deathwatch involvement, but the characters may have difficulty hiding their underhanded motives from these stalwart Marines.

Outcome

Completing their operation on @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.qLLaIGWiU6Lf6Rjy]{Persepolis} earns the characters’ Patron +2 Legitimacy. Otherwise, it is undertaken by another Inquisitor, one who sided with their Patron (@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Sylvestrine Horst} for defending Persepolis, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.sNDdDGlvY5m1HQ4R]{Ksenia Baek} for supporting the uprising), who gains +2 Legitimacy.

If the uprising is defeated: The wider @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald's Howl} is roused to war in a piecemeal manner, with many smaller cells remaining in the shadows, unaware of the wider uprising. @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.qLLaIGWiU6Lf6Rjy]{Persepolis} is, however, able to function as the fulcrum of the Imperium’s counteroffensive, and the cults that do emerge face swift retribution from Macharian @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.6Yav4onpokz5e5jg]{Astra Militarum} regiments, although a few are able to annihilate initial Imperial attacks in ambushes and guerilla engagements.

If the uprising is successful: The@UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{ Herald's Howl} emerge from their hidden places across the Macharian Sector, a united force that wreaks havoc in its emergence, but loses its element of surprise against Imperial reinforcements, having wasted their advantage against local forces. The loss of Persepolis, however, causes catastrophic logistical problems for the Imperial Forces, losing their central hub of authority over the sector.

Strife VI-B
Doom of the Border Worlds

Amid the reports of the sector-spanning Genestealer Cult uprising, six planets that correlate with the recovered Star Map have drawn the attention of the Conclave: Ctesias, Opis, Faustina IV, Cyzicus, Vantaer, and Telekar.

These planets on the edge of the Macharian Sector each have significant strategic importance in the form of resources that could supply the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald's Howl} for an extended campaign, including the forge and hive worlds of Ctesias, Opis, and Faustina IV for manufacturing and the agri worlds Cyzicus and Vantaer for provisioning.

On each affected planet, the defenders have been pushed to a tipping point and will be overwhelmed without concentrated immediate action from the Inquisitors on all six planets. Inquisitorial strike forces would have to be deployed in a protracted campaign to destroy the Patriarchs on each planet — potentially robbing the Conclave of the capability to defend @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.qLLaIGWiU6Lf6Rjy]{Persepolis}. Such a campaign would have to begin with strikes to disable anti-air defences, already controlled by @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cultists} on each affected planet, repelling any attempts to undertake orbital strikes against the cultists.

The only other option is to activate the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-kryptman-protocol]{Kryptman Protocol}. While fleet captains may be hesitant to enact Exterminatus with their vessels at risk from planetary defences, the sleeper agents conditioned by Inquisitor Lord Drake will follow such orders with little concern for their safety. Sacrificing the border worlds is no decision made lightly — many of the worlds that the Kryptman Protocol would destroy are unaffected by these uprisings and are home to vital resources for the Imperium, including agri worlds, hive worlds, and forge worlds. Their loss will have dreadful long-term effects for the sector’s capacity to defend itself. Collectively, they are also home to hundreds of billions.

  • @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus} is the leading proponent of using the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-kryptman-protocol]{Kryptman Protocol}. In his eyes, the worlds that have already become infested by @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cults} are damned, while those left untouched will merely be the next to fall in a disaster that will damn the entire Macharian Sector unless swift, bold action is taken.

  • @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Sylvestrine Horst} is Serranus’ greatest opposition, considering the long-term costs of using the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-kryptman-protocol]{Kryptman Protocol} too extreme for its use to benefit the Macharian Sector.

  • @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.W50MW8gfyrDts9g3]{Aegidius Halikarn} sees aiding the border worlds as an opportunity to rebuild their political order to align with his @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.brh2O5CexxurRbM7.JournalEntryPage.7Aqg1D2wSmKjmzWj]{Recongregationist} philosophy in the wake of the conflict.

Whether characters choose to undertake this operation or favour activating the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-kryptman-protocol]{Kryptman Protocol} so that their attention may be focused on @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.qLLaIGWiU6Lf6Rjy]{Persepolis}, it should be their Patron who makes the deciding argument for or against using the Kryptman Protocol.

Operation

As the Conclave scatters to save the sector, Characters race to deploy on the world of Telekar and begin their campaign of resistance against the occupying Genestealer Cult.

The characters must undertake a series of covert missions if they undertake an operation to recapture the border worlds. This includes scouting, sabotaging planetary defences, and assassinating the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cultists’} chain of command. Time is of the essence, but discretion is essential on these enemy-occupied planets. Several of the captured planets are still home to loyalists holding out or waging guerilla war against the Genestealer Cultists, and characters who discover and rendezvous with such cells of resistance may find the loyalists to have vital local knowledge or intel on the Genestealer Cult forces.

Once anti-air defences are disabled and the Genestealer Cults are in disarray, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.HlxK2pbpx2Uio6bU]{Navis Imperialis} and @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.6Yav4onpokz5e5jg]{Astra Militarum} forces can move to undertake orbital strikes and ground invasions, but with each reclaimed world, paranoia among the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald's Howl} only increases on those yet to fall — warnings of the characters’ operations passed between the cultists lead to heightened security. Elite Genestealer Cultists and @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.KvLrPAQ0gmIWSvfX]{Purestrain Genestealers} are deployed to hunt the characters progressively as the operation continues.

Finally, they must deal with the psychic beacon at the heart of each cult’s operation and likely the most well-defended structure under cultist control. Total purgation is likely the best method to ensure the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Howl} is ceased, but any Inquisitor seeking to study the Herald’s Howl further may attempt to contain the horror through a greater psychic force, technology, or using blanks. Most would consider it heresy to meddle with such monstrosities; any failures to contain it may result in Warp breaches and daemonic activity rising in the area.

Outcome

If characters successfully undertake the operation to destroy the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald's Howl} on the border worlds, their Patron gains +2 Legitimacy. If the border worlds are saved, it is accomplished at a terrible cost to the affected planets, with many functionally refounded during the conquest following the characters’ operations.

If the characters do not undertake this operation, it falls to @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.W50MW8gfyrDts9g3]{Aegidius Halikarn} or @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus}, depending on the decision made regarding the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-kryptman-protocol]{Kryptman Protocol}.

@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.W50MW8gfyrDts9g3]{Aegidius Halikarn} undertakes the operation to liberate the border worlds, losing many acolytes in intense skirmishes, clearing a path for Imperial forces to reclaim the lost planets, earning +2 Legitimacy.

@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus} activates the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-kryptman-protocol]{Kryptman protocols}, destroying the border worlds and, with them, the logistical strength of the Herald's Howl, earning +2 Legitimacy, but at atrocious cost.

The Conclave at War

Beyond Conclave VI’s Strifes, each Inquisitor undertakes dozens of missions with their acolytes to stem the tide of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cult} uprisings and end the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald’s Howl}.

Inquisitor Ksenia Baek

@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.sNDdDGlvY5m1HQ4R]{Ksenia Baek} aids Imperial forces on numerous battlelines; she takes more dangerous and sacrificial actions to contain the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald’s Howl} rather than destroy their psychic beacons. The characters may already have an informant in her retinue (perhaps in the form of Kharket Graan). The informant relays that Baek has been negotiating with some cells of the Herald's Howl, albeit for seemingly loyalist aims, and sending related messages to her @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.brh2O5CexxurRbM7.JournalEntryPage.0vHms9BJQGOVa0dO]{Thorian} peers back on Holy Terra about the Herald’s Howl and the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-kryptman-protocol]{Kryptman Protocol}.

Inquisitor Aegidius Halikarn

The wrath of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.W50MW8gfyrDts9g3]{Aegidius Halikarn} falls upon @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.59y8WFXTbwKRwiRI]{Voll}, on which a @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cult} uprising had largely already succeeded, declaring their commanding Magus the hive world’s new planetary governor. Halikarn arms and orchestrates a counter-revolution of Imperial loyalists against the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald's Howl}, culminating in the Inquisitor personally slaying the usurper planetary governor.

Inquisitor Sylvestrine Horst

@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Sylvestrine Horst} strikes where the fighting is thickest, focusing her defensive efforts on worlds of the most significant strategic importance. On a dozen battlefronts, the tide turns for Imperial forces when reinforcements arrive in the form of the Inquisitor’s saint-masked acolytes. Her greatest triumph is the defence of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.BKMxau7cO5Cy5aXX]{Dao Teyras}. Still, her forces see deployment across the sector, defending Imperial command from the hive spires of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.0g60Fj0fRMDfzYGB]{Macharia} to the city ships of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.wHl3ZP7wM7OQvSLC]{Jotungarth}.

Inquisitor Alis Raud

@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Alis Raud} personally engages @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cult}-controlled voidships in the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.d0lv2v4FkeIb43jj]{Drimor Subsector}, drawing them into a void battle in the turbulent depths of the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.1AsBzkbw2InKayw2]{Ayzinith Abyss}, a largely uncharted region of space that she deftly navigates with such success as to suggest a more profound knowledge of the area. In truth, Raud helps the defence from the sidelines, as a lead on the disappeared heretic @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.X5EFP7IgIUx6CaBW#machariuss-generals]{General Cyrus} has come to light — a threat she deems even more pressing than the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald's Howl}.

Inquisitor Konstan Serranus

@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus} is a vengeful man, and his wrath falls upon the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cultists} on @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.VeiDfnkV55kTAkRw]{Kallastin}. Aware of their numbers and tactics after his captivity, Serranus mobilises an army of the Machine God, gathered from his @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.9frbPZ9v3lFR9Kva]{Adeptus Mechanicus} allies on @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.jB9sg2SDLZJGZrac]{Eskutchax}. The augmented Inquisitor, his acolytes, and an army of skitarii and battle servitors fall upon the Genestealer Cults with mechanical fury, and Serranus is thorough in his purging of any among the Highborn of Kallastin that he believes may be allied to the cultists.

Inquisitor Eskender Thracius

Despite being a traitor in the eyes of several Inquisitors of the Conclave, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius} believes he is loyal to the Imperium and fights against the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald's Howl} with a zeal to match any other Inquisitor. Thracius’ acolytes, armed with esoteric @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#aeldari]{Aeldari} weaponry, come to the beleaguered Imperial forces on @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.nLrpWOo3BjHLB0FG]{Proteus Secundus}, arriving disguised as the Rogue Trader Selim Iaysus. He will be remembered by the people of the Proteus system for his heroism, personally leading his crew to board a @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cult}-controlled battleship and slay their Patriarch with the strange technology gathered on his travels.

Conclave VI Conclusion

As the last fires of the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald's Howl} uprising die across the Macharian Sector, the forces of the Inquisition, instrumental in the Imperial victory, fade back into the shadows. With the greatest threat to the Macharian Sector seemingly defeated, Inquisitorial machinations are once again in motion, both loyalist and heretical…

pages.name: Conclave VII
pages.text:
Conclave VII

With the defeat of the Herald's Howl, the Conclave gathers once more on Mare Cinis, gazing down upon the wounded Persepolis. Each Inquisitor returns bearing fresh scars. The Conclave vie for reinforcement as three loose ends persist: the remnants of the Herald's Howl, Raud’s hunt for an ostensibly dead heretic, and the escape of Eskender Thracius.

Dramatis Personae

In attendance at the seventh Conclave are: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.sNDdDGlvY5m1HQ4R]{Ksenia Baek}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.W50MW8gfyrDts9g3]{Aegidius Halikarn}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Sylvestrine Horst}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Alis Raud}, and @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus}. Characters should note each Inquisitor has a significantly diminished retinue present. Despite their great victories during the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald’s Howl}, tensions between Inquisitors are high.

Intrigues

Characters who suspect @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.sNDdDGlvY5m1HQ4R]{Ksenia Baek} of treachery may investigate her section of @UUID[.Y1wjtyi7JdgHxQiF#mare-cinis]{Mare Cinis} to discern her actions during the war against the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald's Howl}. The information confirms that she had negotiated with several cells of the Herald’s Howl, bargaining their survival to maintain their psychic beacons. Bringing this information to their Patron or the Conclave may result in a second battle erupting in Mare Cinis. @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus} and @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Alis Raud} will swiftly move to declare Baek Excommunicate Traitoris. If this does occur, and Baek is apprehended, she cannot support the Herald's Howl in Strife VII-A: The Star Map.

If @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus} still lives, he is joined by Magos Tal-Theta 661 of the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.9frbPZ9v3lFR9Kva]{Adeptus Mechanicus}, whose Skitarii forces joined Serranus in battle on @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.VeiDfnkV55kTAkRw]{Kallastin}. Characters with a history with the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.9frbPZ9v3lFR9Kva]{Adeptus Mechanicus} or who undertook the operation to cleanse the daemonic corruption from @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.jB9sg2SDLZJGZrac]{Eskutchax} may be able to requisition @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.9frbPZ9v3lFR9Kva]{Adeptus Mechanicus} support on whatever Strife they undertake.

Strife VII-A
The Star Map

The Herald's Howl suffered severe losses across the Macharian Sector, its remnants withdrawing back into the shadowed corners of the sector from which the cult was first spawned. Yet a point of concern remains for the Conclave, as some cells may still be waiting to activate

The star chart first found on the Calvus Station (@UUID[.qMGtMcmwPnXnwPds#strife-i-c-the-fate-of-the-lucanus]{Strife I-C}) held record of nearly every world where the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald's Howl} arose — a symbol of faith, a logistical network, the shape of a doom that could have overwhelmed the Macharian Sector. Yet the Herald’s Howl did not fall upon all of the Star Map’s worlds, leading the Conclave to conclude that they dwell in the shadows of numerous worlds.

  • Among them, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.jB9sg2SDLZJGZrac]{Eskutchax}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.ZIDINp9DtgCCj1Mg]{Harjus}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.zXku6hYsLGOHzcwi]{Res Vilissima}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.A9cvKlA41X8qPyEw]{Paleon}, and, most perverse of all, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.0g60Fj0fRMDfzYGB]{Macharia} itself. The @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Howl’s} inactivity on these worlds begs the question whether some parts of the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cult} threat continue to gather strength, preparing for another sector-wide offensive when their leaders deem the time right.

  • @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Sylvestrine Horst} and @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.W50MW8gfyrDts9g3]{Aegidius Halikarn} urge the Conclave to engage in a joint assault: swift, simultaneous strikes against each remaining cell to bring a final silence to the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald's Howl}.

  • If these cells can communicate with each other, anything short of total eradication would mean one or more cells receiving an early warning, allowing them to scatter and spread their foul mutation to different worlds.

  • None are opposed to acting against this Strife, everyone having seen first-hand the damage these organised @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cults} can do — it is simply a matter of allocating the Inquisition’s dwindling resources after the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Howl’s} last uprising and managing other dire issues about to come to light in the Conclave’s chambers (see @UUID[.AYJ70cmnV5Y6rDDt#strife-vii-b-doom-of-the-border-worlds]{Strife VII-B} and @UUID[.AYJ70cmnV5Y6rDDt#strife-vii-c-doom-of-the-border-worlds]{VII-C}).

Operation

In bringing the light of the God-Emperor to the final shadows concealing the Herald's Howl, the characters are entrusted with destroying the final cell of the Genestealer Cult, embedded on Macharia, shrine world of Saint Macharius, the spiritual heart of the Macharian Sector.

The dense and ever-shifting population of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.0g60Fj0fRMDfzYGB]{Macharia} proves the most significant challenge for locating the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cult}. The number of pilgrims means that even local @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.5Bx7K8k9VgjOZmA4]{Ministorum} priests have little recollection of the faces and names of those who pass by. However, some priests have noted small mutations among the pilgrims and others who have gone to lengths to hide their facial features entirely with wraps and bandages.

Characters may discover that @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.0g60Fj0fRMDfzYGB]{Macharia} has served as a node from which the cult has spread, moving freely aboard pilgrim ships under the guise of the faithful. Through interrogating or shadowing the movements of false pilgrims, characters learn that the cult operates from a network of catacombs beneath the Lord Solar’s Palace, centred on a cleared tomb turned cult hub, named the Sanctuary of the Four-armed Emperor.

Once this location is discovered, the characters' Inquisitorial Patron organises a rendezvous, meeting the characters to prepare and join them to destroy what remains of the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald’s Howl}.

As the characters and their Patron reach the Sanctuary of the Four-armed Emperor, they are confronted by another Inquisitorial force. @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.sNDdDGlvY5m1HQ4R]{Ksenia Baek} and her acolytes do not allow them to assault the sanctuary, holding that the survival of the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald’s Howl} is vital for the survival of the Imperium, as they will split the advance of the Tyranids, lessening the threat directed towards Holy Terra. Inquisitor Baek is willing to kill any characters who do not stand down. If combat ensues, the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cult’s} forces emerge to join the fray, instinctually supporting Ksenia Baek. While the characters’ Patron engages the heretic Inquisitor, they are ordered to locate and destroy the Genestealer Patriarch, without whose synaptic influence the cult will surely crumble.

Outcome

If the characters succeed in destroying the final Patriarch of the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald's Howl}, their Patron earns +1 Legitimacy. They gain the full support of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Sylvestrine Horst} and @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.W50MW8gfyrDts9g3]{Aegidius Halikarn} in claiming the title of Inquisitor Lord. Regardless of whether she survived the engagement, Inquisitor Baek is declared Excommunicate Traitoris.

If the Conclave does not pursue this Strife, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.sNDdDGlvY5m1HQ4R]{Ksenia Baek} warns the surviving @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald's Howl} cells of the approaching danger. @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.W50MW8gfyrDts9g3]{Aegidius Halikarn} finds many supposed dens of heresy empty, with little trace of their presence, save for the Star Map motif left as an almost mocking final trace. The Herald's Howl fractures further: small cells flee across the sector in the bowels of voidships, spreading to other worlds where their twisted faith may be reborn in forgotten shadowed places, beginning their generational cycles once more.

Strife VII-B
Fate of the Daemon-keepers

Under the Conclave chamber’s bright lights, dark and brutal truths are uncovered for all to see. This moment could spell the end for many Inquisitors and shake the Macharian Inquisition to its core.

The Conclave erupts in uproar as @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Sylvestrine Horst} motions that @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Alis Raud} be declared Excommunicate Traitoris. Horst’s spies have observed Raud’s actions when facing daemons and noted that Raud seems more interested in their containment than their banishment.

  • Depending on the events of previous Conclaves, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Horst} may cite the Daemon Engine core from @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.jB9sg2SDLZJGZrac]{Eskutchax} (@UUID[.ugwIBQXf8tEWYSE0#strife-ii-c-the-eskutchax-incongruity]{Strife II-C}) or the daemonhost extracted from @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.wHl3ZP7wM7OQvSLC]{Jotungarth} (@UUID[.1EujWPAAI3xsXmIk#strife-iii-c-the-ghost-of-luna]{Strife III-C}), depending on the outcome of those Strifes. Horst accuses Raud of Radicalism, that keeping a collection of daemons bound into Human bodies is a heresy, for indeed she is using them for some fell purpose, aligning herself with the very abominations that she must eradicate.

  • @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Alis Raud} responds by levelling an accusation at @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Horst}, claiming she has evidence that implicates Horst in the death of Inquisitor Lord Heironymo Drake — logs that her acolytes extracted from the Drake archive show that the Inquisitor Lord was acting on the information provided by Horst when he departed for his disastrous final operation.

  • @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Horst} wilfully admits involvement in her mentor’s death, claiming that it was her duty to the Ordo Hereticus to bring about the downfall of the Inquisitor Lord she believed was a heretic cut from the same cloth as @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Raud} — the Inquisitor Lord was himself a keeper of daemonhosts, as evidenced by the discovery on @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.wHl3ZP7wM7OQvSLC]{Jotungarth} (@UUID[.1EujWPAAI3xsXmIk#strife-iii-c-the-ghost-of-luna]{Strife III-C}). Horst further claims that Drake should be posthumously declared Excommunicate Traitoris.

As these Inquisitors hurl accusations at each other, the characters’ Patron can decide which, if any, Inquisitor is declared a traitor (they will take the characters’ council). If the characters do not choose, their Patron may abstain if they deem other Strifes of greater importance, leaving the debate in a stalemate.

Operation

Tensions rise. Sides are picked. Hands hover over holstered weapons. Unless cooler heads prevail, another Inquisitor will be named a traitor this day

If either Inquisitor is declared Excommunicate Traitoris, the @UUID[.Y1wjtyi7JdgHxQiF#mare-cinis]{Mare Cinis} base erupts into conflict as rival fireteams of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.5rrnycKS5mMDjQJc]{Acolytes} fight to apprehend the traitor or defend their respective Inquisitor.

If @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Sylvestrine Horst} is declared a traitor and pursued, she falls back under a guard of her gold-masked acolytes to her shuttle and flees to the surface of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.qLLaIGWiU6Lf6Rjy]{Persepolis}. Characters hunting her find that she has used her Adepta Sororitas Famulous allies to embed herself in the court of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.X5EFP7IgIUx6CaBW#governance]{Sector Lord Aulus Sejanus}.

Those who apprehend her may attempt to prove her treachery to the Order of the Hallowed Glass and break this alliance. Alternatively, a rogue group of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Horst}'s former acolytes now in service of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.W50MW8gfyrDts9g3]{Aegidius Halikarn} may know how to enter the hive spire covertly. If cornered, Horst holds out to the end. She declares that she is a true loyalist and that @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Raud} and Drake were both heretics for their consorting with daemons.

@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Alis Raud} will likewise fall back to her transport if pursued, her prayer scroll-adorned acolytes providing supporting fire. The Conclave know that Raud is active in the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.d0lv2v4FkeIb43jj]{Drimor Subsector}, where they suspect she likely keeps a base of operations. If characters can access records left at @UUID[.Y1wjtyi7JdgHxQiF#mare-cinis]{Mare Cinis} by Raud, they may learn that her headquarters are on a void fortress at the edge of the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.1AsBzkbw2InKayw2]{Ayzinith Abyss}.

Her void fortress is heavily armed to defend against unauthorised incoming voidships, demanding that the Conclave commandeer @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.HlxK2pbpx2Uio6bU]{Navis Imperialis} vessels destroy it at long distances or undertake a near-suicidal boarding run. A deck at the station's core is the prison of twelve @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-actors.Actor.M6XWkYc0lfuKl2hU]{Daemonhosts} captured by @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Raud} across years of operations. They serve in part as bait, which she believes may draw @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.X5EFP7IgIUx6CaBW#machariuss-generals]{General Cyrus} into the open for the power they may offer if the traitor general still lives. If backed into a corner by an assault that overwhelms her force of acolytes, Raud, galvanised by her @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.brh2O5CexxurRbM7.JournalEntryPage.s88kgPSDiogPL4aB]{Xanthite} philosophy, will unleash daemonhosts, which she attempts to control and drive against the attackers — the damage they cause to the voidstation risks dooming all aboard.

Outcome

If the characters succeed in either operation, their Patron earns +1 Legitimacy and the full support of either @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Sylvestrine Horst} or @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Alis Raud} in claiming the title of Inquisitor Lord (whoever is the most appropriate ally). If the characters’ Patron refuses to denounce Horst or Raud as a traitor and can defuse the tense situation, the two Inquisitors secretly develop a bitter enmity and begin waging a shadow war with their acolytes.

Strife VII-C
Eskender Thracius

The rise of the Herald's Howl forced the Conclave to halt their pursuit of Eskender Thracius. The Inquisitors all agree that Thracius has been privy to the inner workings of the Macharian Inquisition for too long. Now, he must be terminated for good.

Information gathered following @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Thracius}’ revelations has allowed the Conclave to investigate his likely movements and whereabouts further. He operates primarily from the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.y6qA7KARTXADwzeV]{Cytheris Subsector}, with each of his aliases traced to activity on Macharia. Thus, Thracius’ corruption is placed within the spiritual heart of the Macharian Sector.

@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus} is the first to demand this hunt be completed. After being captured due to @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Thracius}’ actions and learning that Thracius has flaunted the use of not only xenos technology but also that of the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#aeldari]{Aeldari}, his hatred for the rogue Inquisitor now knows no bounds. Serranus believes they should purge Thracius’s entire organisation to ensure no hidden traitors or aliases remain.

@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.W50MW8gfyrDts9g3]{Aegidius Halikarn} agrees with @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Serranus} for the most part. Thracius’s sector-spanning web of contacts and anti-xenos resources still proves a boon to the Inquisition. A suitable acolyte or Interrogator could be found to take over, with oversight from the rest of the Conclave.

Operation

Characters begin their pursuit of Thracius by heading to Macharia, now suspected to be the planetary base of his entire operation. As they pull at threads, they discover Thracius has woven his way into influencing many of the planet’s ruling organisations to push his Isstvanist goals.

Characters can begin investigating within the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.HURMpEU0Nnc93Ocv]{Adeptus Ministorum} for any Inquisitorial links that may lead them to @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius}. The Planetary Governor, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.0g60Fj0fRMDfzYGB#personalities-of-macharia]{Arch-Confessor Evaristus Heliacal}, is little help, age clouding whatever memories they may have had of past cooperation with the Inquisition. @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.0g60Fj0fRMDfzYGB#personalities-of-macharia]{Arch-Cardinal Molinair}, however, has a history of regular contact with multiple Inquisitors, including @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Alis Raud} and Kai Varol, one of Thracius’ discarded identities, and the late Inquisitor Lord Heironymo Drake.

Upon learning of Varol’s betrayal, the Arch-Cardinal cannot reveal any further information about their dealing with Inquisitors, suggesting a total lack of memory of these past engagements. The reality of this inability results from Inquisitor Lord Drake's psychic conditioning — @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.0g60Fj0fRMDfzYGB#personalities-of-macharia]{Molinair} cannot discuss their service to the Inquisition other than in direct conversation with the Inquisitor in question. Without the physical presence of Kai Varol, the characters can learn nothing more from him. Savvy players may recognise the opportunity to impersonate Kai Varol using polymorphine and extract the needed information that way

Characters seeking to pursue @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.0g60Fj0fRMDfzYGB#personalities-of-macharia]{Molinair’s} links with @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Thracius} may also learn more through meetings with other leading powers of the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.5Bx7K8k9VgjOZmA4]{Ecclesiarchy}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.HlxK2pbpx2Uio6bU]{Imperial Fleet}, and @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.6Yav4onpokz5e5jg]{Astra Militarum} on @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.0g60Fj0fRMDfzYGB]{Macharia}. Many of these leaders have the same psychic conditioning. Through further investigation, characters discover that @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.0g60Fj0fRMDfzYGB#personalities-of-macharia]{Molinair} oversaw the construction of an Inquisitorial sanctum under orders from Kai Varol.

While the characters undertake this investigation, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius} orders a strike force of his acolytes to shadow the characters, reporting their movements, and attempt to undertake covert assassinations if an opportunity presents itself, in part by stoking rumours among pilgrims that the characters are heretics, in the hope that they may be killed in mob violence.

If the characters prove capable of fending them off, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Thracius} may approach the characters personally. He will offer them a last chance to join his retinue — which they could do if they earnestly believe in his @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.brh2O5CexxurRbM7.JournalEntryPage.UAWh0hEvWDwob6CT]{Isstvanist} ideals or as an underhanded means to infiltrate his innermost circle.

@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Thracius}’ stronghold lies buried beneath the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.0g60Fj0fRMDfzYGB#the-tomb-of-macharius]{Tomb of Macharius}, sheltered by the resting places of ten thousand martyrs, and accessed through the Mausoleum of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.X5EFP7IgIUx6CaBW#machariuss-generals]{Saint Crassus}, one of Saint Macharius’ generals. @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus} and their Patron join the characters to undertake a raid on Thracius’ stronghold. They find it heavily defended by his remaining acolytes, armed with powerful @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#aeldari]{Aeldari} weaponry. Characters who reach the stronghold’s heart find Eskender Thracius, defended by a salvaged @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-actors.Actor.CuYIq94DC9jXSdCG]{Wraithguard}, making his last heretical stand.

Outcome

If the characters capture or kill Inquisitor @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius}, their Patron earns +1 Legitimacy and the full support of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus} in claiming the title of Inquisitor Lord.

If unapprehended, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius} acts quickly to cover his tracks and produce new identities, allowing him to continue his duties to the God-Emperor secretly. Perhaps one or more of his new identities find places among the Macharian Inquisition, allowing him to observe their movements and shield his holy work from the traitors and fools who would threaten to destroy it.

Conclave VII Conclusion

With a final, decisive action, one Inquisitor has demonstrated to the Conclave their worthiness as a successor to Inquisitor Lord Heironymo Drake. But two threats still grow in the Macharian Sector, and the number of active Inquisitors has dwindled — they must gather new allies, train new operatives, and fill empty seats in their ranks. The Inquisition cannot rest.

pages.name: Epilogue
pages.text:
Epilogue

Heresies of all kinds have wracked the Macharian Sector, but it is no stranger to turbulent times. In the wake of disaster, the great machine of the Imperium will dust off the corpses and do its best to pick up where it left off. Holy Terra demands its tithe, and those in power will see it delivered once more.

The outcome of your Heresies Macharia campaign and the fate of its Inquisitors will no doubt differ from any other. The following are some examples of where aspects of the campaign may lead, including some plots and intrigues left lingering in the wake of yet another sector-wide upheaval.

The sector’s newly endorsed Inquisitor Lord bears the burden of getting the Inquisition back on track. There are no doubt seats to fill, power vacuums to tend to, and stringent cells and resources across the sector to bring back into the fold. The Macharian Inquisition is indeed in a weakened state, and it will take the efforts of its most esteemed Inquisitor to build it back up.

Aspects of the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-kryptman-protocol]{Kryptman Protocol} remain active across the sector. The remaining Inquisitors must decide whether to investigate its protocols further and wield it as the weapon Inquisitor Drake intended it to be or dismantle and deprogram its components so that they may never be used again. Regardless of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.sNDdDGlvY5m1HQ4R]{Ksenia Baek}’s fate, she contacted her peers in Segmentum Solar. These agents of the Adeptus Terra may take an interest in finishing what she considered a viable option — combining the @UUID[.Y1wjtyi7JdgHxQiF#mare-cinis]{Herald’s Howl} and @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-kryptman-protocol]{Kryptman Protocols} to sacrifice the Macharian Sector in the name of Holy Terra, buying time against Hive Fleet Leviathan.

The last remnants of the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald’s Howl} have gone into hiding. @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cultists} are accustomed to playing a long game; many seek new spaces to spend generations rebuilding their hidden armies. Though characters are likely to see a decrease in Genestealer Cult activity across the sector, plentiful cells still need rooting out — they are a threat that should not be forgotten.

@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius} may be defeated or on the run, but the results of his @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.brh2O5CexxurRbM7.JournalEntryPage.UAWh0hEvWDwob6CT]{Isstvanian} plotting are yet to come to fruition — what of the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#aeldari]{Aeldari} craftworld he once sought to draw into the sector to spark conflict.

Would a wounded Imperium be able to come out on top against such a powerful alien foe? What secrets has @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Thracius} uncovered that could aid the Inquisition in cleaning up his mess?

@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Alis Raud}’s obsession with the heretic @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.X5EFP7IgIUx6CaBW#machariuss-generals]{General Cyrus} — that he still somehow lives and plots from the shadows — may warrant further investigation. What pieces she has gathered indicate a plot more secretive and existentially dangerous to the Imperium, yet just as widespread and troublesome as the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald’s Howl}.

What is Next?

The outcome of the Heresies Macharia may leave many issues in the sector unresolved that characters can pick up and continue to investigate, especially those relating to their Patron’s Philosophy. What remains of their Inquisitor’s plans that they can fulfil? With many threats quelled across the sector, now may be the perfect time for their Patron to make their move.

Consider the options available in @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.SJPyRkdBEOCtmD8R]{Sector Threats} and advice in @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK]{Running Inquisition Adventures} to build brand new sector-spanning missions and campaigns. Now may be the chance for characters to focus on a new threat, one better fitting their Ordo’s mission.

Your characters' actions in the Heresies Macharia may have elevated them to a higher position in their Patron’s retinue. This improved position comes with greater responsibility and autonomy — they will be expected to solve more problems without their Patron’s oversight and utilising their own accumulated resources. For completing the campaign, consider granting them their own prominent base of operations or personal voidship to traverse the sector and continue their adventures.

Finally, keep an eye out for future Imperium Maledictum supplements. More thrilling adventures and ways to play the game are coming for Inquisition characters and those from other Factions.

pages.name: Acolytes of the Inquisition
pages.text:
‘Get yourself together before the Inquisitor gets a look at you. Lesson number one: fear her just as much as you would your enemies. She’ll throw you out the airlock if you’re not presentable for her court.’

— Savantas, Ordo Hereticus Interrogator

As acolytes of the Inquisition, there are many paths your character may walk in service to their Patron. This chapter outlines the essential elements of character creation from @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.uJURMn2glWHhjqJk.JournalEntryPage.d84T4PgIPRdQQnzh]{Imperium Maledictum} alongside new options for building characters who form part of the Inquisition’s guiding hand within the Macharian Sector. While not all aspects of core character creation are discussed here in detail, the following pages provide the overview you need to create your own acolyte of the Inquisition without referencing the core book directly.

Within this chapter of The Inquisition Player’s Guide, you will find new Origins for characters hailing from various Inquisition-related backgrounds. Records of each of the Macharian Sector’s existing @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.uJURMn2glWHhjqJk.JournalEntryPage.ZJ4j0hrbxg7bL2K4]{Factions}, their dealings with the Inquisition, how characters from these Factions might find themselves drawn into the Inquisition’s orbit, and how their Faction may feel about this association.

The major Inquisition Ordos of Hereticus and Xenos receive deeper examination than the core book provides (@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.uJURMn2glWHhjqJk.JournalEntryPage.GFKCnze9kOgNTrOw]{Imperium Maledictum}), with Ordo Malleus included as an entirely new Inquisition Faction to incorporate into your campaign. Four new Roles — the Assassin, the Cruciator, the Explicator, and the Seeker — flesh out the ways your character might serve the Inquisition directly, and a variety of Connections and Goals provide extra Inquisition flavour for characters of any Origin or Faction.

While this chapter outlines the entire character creation process, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.uJURMn2glWHhjqJk]{Creating Your Character} of Imperium Maledictum goes into much further depth regarding Characteristics, Talents, Duties, Divinations, Advances, and Experience Points that can assist in character creation and growth. Remember that the options in The Inquisition Player’s Guide are expanded to be used with other Imperium Maledictum resources: feel free to combine elements until you’ve crafted the perfect character for your campaigns within the Macharian Sector.

Note that any Equipment or Talents listed in italics can be found in Imperium Maledictum

For the Inquisition Guide to work with the integrated Character Creator, the correct Origin table must be set in the Table Settings (found in the system section of the Configure Settings menu). The table provided by this module is @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-tables.RollTable.KGkYtn1T21Gdrl5e]{Inquisition Origins}.

Acolyte Creation Summary

To create your acolyte, there are eight steps to follow that should be recorded on your character sheet. Here, we provide a brief overview of these steps and relevant references. In many cases, you can roll randomly to select your character’s traits and receive bonus XP to spend in return, or make more deliberate selections and receive no bonus XP.

1) CHARACTERISTICS

These are your character’s raw physical and mental attributes: Weapon Skill (WS), Ballistic Skill (BS), Strength (STR), Toughness (TGH), Agility (AG), Intelligence (INT), Perception (PER), Willpower (WIL), and Fellowship (FEL). @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.uJURMn2glWHhjqJk.JournalEntryPage.jbPZKcb8972zfHMm]{Imperium Maledictum} provides greater detail about Characteristics and their applications.

2) ORIGIN

Your Origin describes the circumstances of your early life. Your Characteristics and possibly your Faction and Role should align with your chosen Origin. Choose from one of the following options; if you determine your Origin randomly, gain 25 XP:

  • The planetary from @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.uJURMn2glWHhjqJk.JournalEntryPage.IOuNLIGWoHRDvHab]{Origins} Imperium Maledictum.

  • The @UUID[.EvU32m4F3PbGoXdm]{Inquisition Origins}, a selection of Origins that would make a character stand out to an Inquisitor, making them ripe for recruitment.

3) FACTION

Your Faction is the group that raised and trained you, likely for a particular Duty. You can choose from one of the following options; if you determine your Faction randomly, you gain 75 XP:

  • Characters from a @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.uJURMn2glWHhjqJk.JournalEntryPage.ZJ4j0hrbxg7bL2K4]{Faction} outside the Inquisition should consult Imperium Maledictum for ideas on how their character relates to the Inquisition.

  • Characters having risen through the ranks of the Inquisition itself should choose one of the @UUID[.oWdbzXo6SveXsQj4]{Major Ordo Factions}. This Faction choice may match that of your Patrons, but it is unnecessary.

4) ROLE
